editorial:
Imagine a mobster family trying to live quietly in a small French town, but they just cannot stop being themselves. That is the fun setup here. Giovanni, now calling himself Fred Blake, is a former Mafia boss hiding under witness protection with his wife and two kids. The town is sleepy and peaceful, but this family brings chaos everywhere they go. The wife blows up a grocery store over rude service, the daughter beats up classmates, and the son runs a school scam. It is dark, silly, and surprisingly charming all at once. Robert De Niro plays Giovanni with that classic tough-guy energy, while Michelle Pfeiffer steals scenes as the fiery wife who refuses to be pushed around.

The action picks up in the second half when the mob finally tracks them down, leading to a wild shootout in the town. The pacing is brisk and the laughs come steadily, though some jokes land better than others. The movie works best when it leans into the family dynamic rather than the violence. If you enjoy dark comedies with a crime twist, this is a fun weekend pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: The mob finally locates the family and sends hitmen to the French town. A big shootout breaks out at a local event, and Giovanni fights back using his old mob skills. The family survives the attack, but their cover is blown, so they must relocate again. In the final scenes, they settle into a new town and Giovanni continues writing his memoirs, showing that no matter where they go, they will always be themselves.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies with a crime twist and big-name casts.
